genreClassification.rationale: Motorhead's 'Ace of Spades' is classic punk/heavy metal, matching the raw crunch tone.

Ollama.targetTone: Mid-gain, aggressive crunch with bite and sustain
gearHypotheses: Marshall JCM family (or similar British rock stack)
Hot Rod or high-gain Tube Screamer style pedal

finalVerdict.targetTone: raw cranked Marshall punk-metal crunch with clipped mids
corrections: replace mid-gain with cranked high-gain crunch
drop fuzz phrasing; use dirty amp grind

gp180.choicePolicy: Focus on high-gain, aggressive British tones (Marshall/Plexi style) with a tight, mid-focused crunch.
gp180.bestMatchSummary: A high-gain signal chain utilizing an OD boost for initial grit, followed by a classic Marshall-style amp model and 4x12 cabinet to achieve the raw, punk-metal grind required.

blocks.purpose: Clean up pick noise and hum inherent in high-gain punk rock recordings.
blocks.gap: None

blocks.purpose: Provide initial aggressive grit and boost the signal into the high-gain amp section.
blocks.gap: The 'OD 9' or 'Green OD' might offer more character, but a clean Boost is best for maximizing raw crunch without adding unwanted coloration.

blocks.purpose: Add the necessary buzzsaw crunch and aggressive mid-range bite characteristic of punk/metal tones.
blocks.gap: While 'Distortion' is available, RAT-style provides a more raw, biting, and aggressively mid-focused tone suitable for this genre.

blocks.purpose: Simulate the classic Marshall Plexi/JCM tone, providing the core raw British crunch and power-chord foundation.
blocks.gap: None

blocks.purpose: Provide the classic Marshall-era cabinet sound and necessary mid-range punch for a tight, upfront sound.

warnings: The tone requires aggressive mid-range focus, achieved here by stacking a Boost/RAT-style distortion into the UK 50 amp model. This combination is designed to mimic cranked Marshall Plexi tones.
All time-based and ambient effects (Chorus, Delay, Reverb) are deactivated or bypassed to maintain the required dry, immediate punk-metal sound.

improvements.summary: Upgrade IR for better cabinet realism and mid-range punch.

proposals.reason: Enhance Marshall 4x12 character and aggressive mids.
